acceptanceCriteria: Pin the exact implementation-time Pi release and executable digest, beginning with observed 0.99.1; its native install/discover/upgrade/disable/uninstall and TUI/RPC/print/JSON tool/context tests pass with isolated settings and an offline provider.

Trust negatives, compaction/retry/tree/fork/reload/session replacement, concurrent tool behavior and SIGINT/SIGTERM/timeout descendant cleanup pass on each admitted OS/architecture tuple; missing tuples remain explicit.

Core adapter admission, runtime envelope validation, manifests, compatibility matrix, package versions and tests advance together; peer dependency packaging never grants runtime compatibility. V1-0446 remains coordinated.
Retain failed qualification runs and rollback; no protected authority or FULL qualification is claimed without its separately required exact-image campaign.
body:
Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. cmd/corvint/pi_adapter.go:84 refuses every host version except piHostVersion (0.85.1) with unsupported-host-version, so users on current Pi get a degraded adapter. Qualify 0.87 with the native TUI host test and add it to the exact tested tuple.

2026-09-29 owner-requested Pi research: installed host changed from 0.85.1 to 0.99.1 during research; both native test invocations failed their exact version assertion. Official Pi main currently names 0.99.1; Context7 exact reference 0.99.0. Expand this existing qualification ticket to a pinned current-host target chosen at implementation, preserving the original 0.87 historical finding. Do not broaden an admitted version range from a peer manifest or source-level test. Research/checkpoint: /tmp/corvint-pi-research-20260929/proposal.json; regressions 21/21 PASS, live modern qualification FAILED. Installed package is registered but no modern support is delivered. Related V1-0446 package/version coupling and V1-0448 protected-runtime defects remain separate.

2026-09-29 implementation evidence (deduplicated in owning Pi ticket): Confirmed build-time review defect: initial combined adapter 0.3.0 wiring SIGINT/SIGTERM only closed legacy runner, leaving detached Core/Tasks/workflow owned groups outside cleanup. Expected joined interruption before host exit. Root repair wires all owned services into signal boundary and adds reusable cancel + ordering regression; focused evidence /private/tmp/corvint-pi-wave/interrupt-repair.log. Combined native interruption qualification and independent review remain required. Original package lifecycle checks passed exact0.99.1; no FULL or ticket completion claim.
title: Qualify a pinned current Pi host for the native Corvint package
